content.short: Global payments app with multi-currency accounts and instant transfers across 80+ countries.
content.description: Due lets individuals and businesses hold, send, receive and exchange money in several currencies and stablecoins at the real exchange rate. Transfers reach bank accounts and mobile wallets in more than 80 countries in seconds, which suits paying suppliers, staff or family abroad. Fintechs, payroll providers and banks can use the same rails through Due's API.
content.meta: Hold multiple currencies and stablecoins and send money to banks or mobile wallets in 80+ countries in seconds with Due.
